title: Charming Cottage - East Nashville
description:
Gather your friends and family and enjoy our centrally-located East Nashville home. Only a quick 10 minute drive to Broadway, our home is a peaceful retreat after fun and adventure around town. Includes 2 king beds, 1 living room sleeper sofa, 2 bathrooms, and a big beautiful porch. TVs and private parking included!

The space
— SLEEPING SITUATION —

*Total occupancy is 6 people max*

Bedroom 1: King bed
- Sleeps 2
- Attached full bathroom includes vanity with large shower.

Bedroom 2: King bed
- Sleeps 2
- Detached full bathroom includes vanity with large shower and combo tub & shower (access via shared space).

Shared Space: Pullout Sofa Bed
- Sleeps 2
- Detached full bathroom includes vanity with large shower and combo tub & shower (access via shared space).

Guest access
Guests have access to the whole home.

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is mostly quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
